brainlife.desc: Set of images (any browser format) in an images/ folder, indexed by images.json; shown as a gallery, mostly QC figures.
brainlife.name: generic/images

original.desc: Collection of various images with metadata
original.readme:
This datatype stores N number of images (with any image format supported by the modern browser)  and displays them in a table of 4 columns. images.json must enumerate all images stored inside /images subdirectory. 

We recommend using HTML datatype instead of this datatype.

brainlife.readme:
This datatype stores N number of images (with any image format supported by the modern browser)  and displays them in a table of 4 columns. images.json must enumerate all images stored inside /images subdirectory. 

We recommend using HTML datatype instead of this datatype.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/generic.images.json

files.desc: JSON index: an "images" array of {filename, name, desc}.
Folder of image files listed in images.json.

identifying_risks: Figures may show subject IDs, dates or anatomy of one participant.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level derived figures without direct identifiers are Tier 2.
sharing_cautions: Check embedded labels and titles for identifiers before sharing.
tier_conditions: Tier 1 for group-level or non-human figures.
Tier 3 if it shows recognisable facial anatomy or names.

intended_use: Visual QC of App results, e.g. registration, tracts or tract profiles.
not_suitable_for: Input to analysis Apps; prefer report/html for rich reports.
